jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A single seamless square 2D hand-painted neutral terrain detail texture for a colorful cartoon puzzle saga map. Top-down flat texture, NOT a scene, not an atlas. Very pale warm ivory base with a handful of large softly curved pale-gray/cream color patches, sparse tiny simplified brush flecks and a few abstract small rounded grass strokes. Extremely low contrast (white to pale warm gray only), meant to be tinted green in a game shader. Broad simple painted shapes, cheerful clean casual-game illustration. The texture is uniformly lit; no perspective, no directional shadow, no road, no buildings, no objects, no borders, no text, no black areas, no high-frequency noise. Seamless edges matching in all directions. Opaque background. It should give flat-colored ground a soft painted character without looking busy.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE standalone golden cartoon crown reward ornament for the level buttons of Magic Mail, a polished casual puzzle saga game. Front view, symmetric simple three rounded prongs with three golden round bead tips, curved low gold band. Big readable shapes, illustrated 2D painted cartoon, luminous rounded golden yellow and warm orange shading, one broad cream highlight, small simple embossed envelope mark centered on band. Clean continuous warm-white cream outline around the complete silhouette, same style as simple hand-painted mailboxes and illustrated glowing postal lamps. Cheerful plump toy-like illustration, NOT detailed realistic metal or a studio 3D render. No jewels, fur, sparkles, cast shadows or surrounding glow fog. Exactly one crown centered, generous transparent margins, no cropping. Clean actual transparent background, alpha zero exterior; no checkerboard, text, floor, additional items or atlas.

Use case: game-asset. Create ONE production-quality 2D illustrated ground plate for an original cheerful magical postal puzzle-game map. This is a flat TOP-DOWN UV texture, NOT a perspective scene or a screenshot. Square image, fully opaque, green terrain fills every pixel. A broad smooth LIGHT APPLE-GREEN grass corridor runs STRAIGHT vertically through the exact center from bottom edge to top edge, uniform width about 38% of image. Both shoulders are rich medium emerald-green grass, broad and equally visible. The central corridor is gently inset: a VERY narrow soft darker green painted bevel and a clean soft lighter edge, almost flat, absolutely not a canyon. Sophisticated simple casual-game cartoon art: big clean curved color shapes, soft luminous gradients with matte painted finish, a few broad alternating light-green swept color bands crossing the corridor, quiet organic emerald patches on the shoulders, only a FEW tiny understated grass flecks at outer margins. The central path stays empty and clean for level buttons. Good illustrative color separation and smooth hand-drawn curves, no muddy washed-out tint, no random repeated stamps, no noisy brushwork, no leaf motifs scattered everywhere. TOP AND BOTTOM EDGES MATCH perfectly for vertical looping; corridor and shoulder colors connect at the ends. Left/right outer edges are quiet uniform emerald grass. No sky, horizon, camera perspective, road markings, ribbon, levels, UI, text, logo, objects, flowers, trees, rocks, characters, bridges or water. All 3 ground regions are drawn TOGETHER in this single finished illustrated terrain plate. Original game art, not copying any specific game layout.
